6754-7084-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Eusocial Engineering triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

339-677-6495-6968.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

586-864-3125-5256-5631.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-5256-5631.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Skeleton Crew.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1671-5226-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Simic Growth Chamber.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Simic Growth Chamber from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Lithatog ability
Repeat.

1978-2347-3430-5793.description:
Activate Firemind Vessel by tapping it, adding six mana due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Firemind Vessel which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.

2103-5900-7722.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Lilysplash Mentor.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3693-5224-7693.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
2034-3693-5224-7693.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

891-5686-7424.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3334-3899-4552-5089.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Karn, the Great Creator
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Ley Weaver with "Elf" chosen

1399-1606-1671-7040.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

2034-2459-4053-6989.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rograkh.
Cast Rograkh from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

522-5147-6972.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Melira.
When Melira dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1978-2585-4694.description:
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Grim Monolith.
Repeat.

4772-4968-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Doubling Season.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
4772-4968-6919.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

2034-4593-6291-6752.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating a 1/1 Thopter and a 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token.
When the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter enter the battlefield, Haliya triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-4593-6291-6752.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Phyrexian Mites and/or Thopters.

3951-4875-5703-6441.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
3951-4875-5703-6441.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

969-3259-6438.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-3259-6438.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Elsha, triggering Breath of Fury and Elsha.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

81-4824-6287.notablePrerequisites:
Mimeoplasm does not have summoning sickness and has power 6 or greater.
Soliton and Kami of Whispered Hopes are exiled by Mimeoplasm.
81-4824-6287.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least six {U}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Soliton.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

876-2907-6246.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting a creature you control.
The creature triggers, causing you to reveal the top card of your library and put it onto the battlefield if it's a land card, or put it into your hand otherwise.
If a land was put onto the battlefield, each Scute Swarm you control triggers, creating either that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens or that many token copies of Scute Swarm.
Resolve the equip ability from step 1.
Repeat as able.

3693-4899-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Phyrexian Devourer's ability by exiling the top card of your library, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Marvin equal to the exiled card's mana value.
Repeat step 1 as desired or until you have an empty library.
Activate Marvin using Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from Marvin, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 3 as desired.

2034-4499-5790.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls more creatures than you.
2034-4499-5790.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Beza.
When Beza enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create two 1/1 Fish creature tokens, and a Treasure token if an opponent controls more lands than you.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Fish, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1061-4183.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator with haste.
Activate the Timestream Navigator token by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library from the battlefield, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

757-4221-4883-5087.notablePrerequisites:
Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
It is your precombat main phase.
757-4221-4883-5087.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Contagion Clasp by paying {4} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, putting an eon counter on Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

190-202-3507-4591.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Lich and causing each opponent to create a token copy of Lich, and lose life equal to their life totals due to Lich's effect.
You cannot lose the game due to having 0 or less life due to Platinum Angel.
Cast Dismantling Wave by paying {2}{W}, destroying each opponent's Lich.
Each opponent's Lich triggers, causing them to lose the game.

2232-2858-3273-3404.description:
Pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice putting Chandra, the Firebrand onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra, Torch of Defiance to your hand.
+1 Chandra, the Firebrand targeting an opponent.
Then pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice once again, putting Chandra, Torch of Defiance onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra, the Firebrand to your hand.
+1 Chandra adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

1787-1802-2060-4120.description:
Cast Gideon's Sacrifice by paying {W}, causing all damage that would be dealt this turn to you or to permanents you control to be dealt to Crystalline Crawler instead.
Activate Thrashing Wumpus by paying {B}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Gideon's Sacrifice redirects damage to Crawler, which results in at least four +1/+1 counters being placed on it instead due to Vigor.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first activated ability at least once by removing at least one +1/+1 counter from it, adding at least {B}.
Repeat from step 2.

1335-2060-2744-3062.notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1335-2060-2744-3062.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1}, creating a 1/1 Elemental token.
Cathars' Crusade triggers putting two +1/+1 counter to all creatures you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2568-3002.description: Rest in Peace prevents cards from going to the graveyard, so Energy Field isn't sacrificed preventing damage to you.

587-3205-5218.description:
Discard Eidolon to Dream Halls' effect to cast Loon.
Return Eidolon to your hand.
When Loon enters, draw two cards and put two cards on the bottom of your library and return Loon to your hand.
Repeat.
